mapper.select: SELECT tlsr.LH_MACHINE_CODE, tlsr.SPEC_CODE, tlsr.MOLD_QTY, tlmi.MAX_MOLD_NUM AS MOULD_NUMBER, mpm.PRODUCT_CODE, tlsr.EMBRYO_CODE, mpc.PRODUCT_CODE AS CONSTRUCTION_PRODUCT_CODE, mpm.MOULD_CODE FROM t_lh_schedule_result tlsr LEFT JOIN t_lh_machine_info tlmi ON tlmi.MACHINE_CODE = tlsr.LH_MACHINE_CODE AND tlmi.FACTORY_CODE = tlsr.FACTORY_CODE AND IFNULL(tlmi.IS_DELETE, 0) = 0 LEFT JOIN t_mdm_product_construction mpc ON mpc.SPEC_CODE = tlsr.SPEC_CODE AND mpc.FACTORY_CODE = tlsr.FACTORY_CODE AND IFNULL(mpc.IS_DELETE, 0) = 0 LEFT JOIN t_mdm_product_model_relation mpm ON mpm.FACTORY_CODE = tlsr.FACTORY_CODE AND mpm.SPEC_CODE = tlsr.SPEC_CODE where IFNULL(tlsr.IS_DELETE, 0) = 0 AND (tlsr.CLASS1_PLAN_QTY > 0 OR tlsr.CLASS2_PLAN_QTY > 0) AND tlsr.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND tlsr.SCHEDULE_DATE = #{vulcanizingDate,jdbcType=DATE}
